artworks.title: Endpaper with Animals
artworks.medium: woodcut; brocade endpaper in gold on white paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of numerous animals depicted on a single sheet of paper. The drawing features a variety of animals intricately placed in rows, including lions, elephants, camels, deer, and various other mammals and reptiles. Each animal is stylized with fine lines detailing their fur and features, and they are arranged in an orderly fashion across the sheet. The outlines of the animals are in green or brown ink. The drawing is detailed, with some animals depicted in dynamic poses, interacting with the landscape or with other creatures.

artworks.title: Endpaper - "Zwarg Gesellschaft"
artworks.medium: woodcut; brocade endpaper in gold on deep rose prepared paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a patterned design featuring whimsical characters. The drawing presents a series of figures stylized in a folk art manner, arranged in a grid-like pattern on a dark red background. Each row showcases different characters in various poses, seemingly engaging with each other or interacting with small attributes like flowers and goblets, and the environment, including small animals and plants depicted alongside them. The figures are illustrated with exaggerated features and cartoon-like expressions. The border surrounding the figures is composed of thin lines, separating the rows and adding structure to the design. The overall composition suggests a sense of storytelling or sequential narrative, often found in traditional storytelling art forms.

artworks.title: Endpaper with Scenes of the Trades
artworks.medium: woodcut in printed in gold metallic ink on hand-washed tan-green laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a series of small, detailed scenes depicting various activities. The illustration consists of numerous horizontal rows, each filled with multiple vignettes showing different interactions and events. These scenes are drawn with a focus on storytelling, presenting figures engaged in tasks like building, playing, conversing, and interacting with various objects. The left border appears to have more pronounced imagery compared to the right side. The use of a consistent color palette and artistic style across the image creates a uniform and cohesive presentation. The figures and activities depicted give it a lively and bustling atmosphere, showcasing a wide range of human activities and everyday life scenarios.

artworks.title: Endpaper with Birds
artworks.medium: woodcut; brocade endpaper in gold on pale rose prepared paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various birds. The drawing features numerous bird silhouettes in a single shade of light green against a tan-colored background. The birds are shown in various poses, including flying, perched, or standing. The border of the drawing is outlined by a thin line enclosing the bird motifs. The paper shows signs of age with visible creases and tears at the edges. The style of the drawing is reminiscent of traditional and folk art, focusing on pattern and form.

artworks.title: Endpaper with Saints
artworks.medium: woodcut in gold metallic ink on hand-washed yellow-green paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a grid of figures with halos. It shows a multi-row grid of rectangular panels, each featuring a human figure with a halo around their head. The figures are set against a muted background that resembles aged material. They are depicted in different poses and holding various objects. The artwork is detailed and resembles traditional religious iconography, similar to that seen in medieval manuscripts or ecclesiastical art.

artworks.title: Endpaper
artworks.medium: woodcut in gold metallic ink on hand-washed  purple paper
artworks.description: The image displays a repeating pattern of small checkered squares creating a grid-like formation. The grid covers the central area and resembles a woven tapestry or window pane pattern viewed from above. The alternating golden and dark colored squares create a chessboard-like appearance, bordered by a muted, darker tone framing the composition.

artworks.title: Endpaper
artworks.medium: woodcut in gold metallic ink on hand-washed  orange paper

artworks.title: Endpaper with Birds
artworks.medium: woodcut in gold metallic ink on hand-washed red paper
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of different birds. The artwork displays an intricate arrangement of numerous birds illustrated with golden lines on a brown background. Each bird is unique, with styles varying from sparrows to peacocks and turkeys, all with detailed feather illustrations. The composition is symmetrical and is bordered by a decorative frame. A script at the bottom adds an authentic touch to the piece.

artworks.title: Endpaper with Four Circus (?) Scenes
artworks.medium: woodcut in gold metallic ink on hand-washed blue paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a series of engraved narrative scenes. The artwork comprises four separate scenes, each intricately detailed and depicted in gold against a deep blue background. The upper left scene shows a group of figures in a hierarchical arrangement. The upper right scene presents figures gathered around a table engaged in conversation. The lower left scene features a group with one person pointing. The lower right panel shows figures congregated around a structure. The piece suggests themes of social interaction and storytelling and is in the style of traditional Renaissance narrative art.

artworks.title: Endpaper with Three Bands of Courtly Scenes
artworks.medium: woodcut in gold metallic ink on hand-washed rose paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a narrative scene divided into panels, illustrating various figures and structures in a medieval setting. The painting is executed on a richly textured red background with golden figures and architectural elements. The figures are depicted in profile or engaging poses. Trees and building facades are included in the composition, emphasizing an outdoor or courtyard setting. The painting comprises different sections, each with distinct activities and arrangements, capturing scenes that might represent chivalric or courtly events. The use of gold on the red cloth suggests a luxurious and intricate style typical of historical decoration.

artworks.title: Endpaper with Scenes of the Trades
artworks.medium: woodcut printed in gold metallic ink on hand-washed blue paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of historical scenes set against a deep blue background. The artwork features numerous small, detailed vignettes in warm hues against the blue. Each scene is enclosed, creating a grid-like pattern across the canvas. In each vignette, figures are engaging in various activities, representing narratives. The style resembles that of textile patterns or historically significant visual storytelling mediums. The scenes are packed close together, showcasing a wealth of detail and reflecting different aspects of daily life or historical events. The style is reminiscent of an anonymous folk or historical illustrator emphasizing storytelling through detailed miniatures.

artworks.title: Endpaper with Birds
artworks.medium: woodcut in gold metallic ink on hand-washed gray-purple paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of various birds and fowl. The artwork features different bird species depicted in a stylized manner in shades of brown and gold against a deep brown background. The birds are arranged across the canvas in a harmonious pattern, each distinct in pose and features. The painting's texture appears rich and complex, with fine lines creating the impression of feathers and details in the birds' plumage. The border of the painting includes decorative motifs. The artwork reflects a balanced blend of natural elements and artistic stylization.

artworks.title: Endpaper with Animals
artworks.medium: woodcut in gold metallic ink on hand-washed  yellow paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various animals arranged on a page. The image is filled with intricate outlines and silhouettes of different animals depicted in a golden hue against a muted background. Various creatures, such as elephants, bears, camels, and other recognizable wildlife species, are arranged in structured rows and sections that fill two pages. The animals are decorated with detailed patterns and textures that give depth and intricacy.

artworks.title: War (The Accusers of Theft, Adultery, Murder)
artworks.medium: engraving
artworks.description: In the image, there are three full-body figures standing closely together. The individuals are positioned in a row, with the center and right figures facing forward while the left figure is turned slightly towards the right. The central character has a despondent facial expression, with droopy eyes and mouth, and features a beard and long, disheveled hair. The hair of the left figure appears wild and spiked, while the right figure has short, combed-back hair. Attire varies among them, with the left figure seemingly clad in a scaled garment or armor, the central figure draped in a flowing garment, and the right figure appearing shirtless. The right figure is holding a large sword upright against his shoulder with both hands. The background consists of vertical striations that may represent wood or a cave-like setting. The words "Theft," "Adultery," and "Murder" are written above the figures. Below the image, an inscription indicates the scene is related to "The Last Judgment," attributed to W. Blake.

artworks.title: The Accusers of Theft, Adultery, Murder (War)
artworks.medium: color-printed etching
artworks.description: The image shows three full-length figures standing closely together, each with distinct postures. The first figure on the left has curly brown hair and is dressed in a textured, gold-hued garment. The central figure has a pale complexion, a thick blond beard, and wears a crown of gold. He is draped in a black outfit and appears to be grasping his chin with both hands. The third figure on the right has curly blond hair and a muscular build, holding a large, black sword in both hands. He is partially clothed in a blue garment wrapped around his torso. The background consists of swirling dark and reddish tones.

artworks.title: Unknown subject (Let Him look up into the Heaven and laugh in the bright air)
artworks.medium: engraving and relief-etching
artworks.description: This is a detailed monochromatic print featuring two figures, each in a kneeling pose. The figures are shown from the waist down to the knees, with muscular legs. The figures appear to lean forward, with their upper bodies not visible in this portion of the image. There are two mask-like faces with distinct features such as wide eyes and carved details at the bottom right. No specific facial features or hair can be seen. The figures are clothed in simple, form-fitting garments. The surrounding environment includes abstract lines resembling trees, organic forms, and an abstract geometric design. The print is signed by W. Blake.

artworks.title: The Chaining of Orc
artworks.medium: relief etching
artworks.description: Three human figures are visible in the image. Two are standing upright, with the one on the left leaning forward and covering their face with one hand. The other standing figure has raised hands and a slight forward gaze. Both have distinct facial features and curly hair with halos sketched around their heads. The third figure is lying down with their upper body turned to the side. The figures appear nude with no clothing. The background shows a textured sky with swirling patterns resembling clouds, and a textured surface beneath the figures adds depth to the scene.

artworks.title: Lear and Cordelia
artworks.artist: Thomas Butts, Jr. after William Blake
artworks.medium: engraving
artworks.description: The image shows two figures captured from the upper body. One figure on the left is in profile, facing towards the figure on the right. This figure has long hair and a beard, while the figure on the right appears to be looking at the first figure. She has long hair and seems to be holding a veil or shawl over her head and shoulders. Both figures are dressed in flowing garments, with the details of the clothing unclear due to the artistic style. The background consists of fine, horizontal lines, and there are no visible jewelry or objects. The art style and stippling give the image an etched appearance. Below the figures, there is cursive writing indicating attribution as "Drawn and engraved by W.B."

artworks.title: Lear and Cordelia
artworks.artist: Thomas Butts, Jr. after William Blake
artworks.medium: engraving
artworks.description: Two figures are shown closely together, depicted from the chest upwards. The figure on the left is an older person with long, wavy hair and a large flowing beard, looking at the figure on the right. The other figure appears younger with long wavy hair framing a youthful face, resting their chin on their hand. The background consists of crosshatched patterns enclosed in an oval frame.

artworks.title: Lear and Cordelia
artworks.artist: Thomas Butts, Jr. after William Blake
artworks.medium: engraving
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals from the chest up. The person on the left has a long beard and wavy hair, looking towards the right. The person on the right has long, wavy hair, delicate eyes, and soft features, with one hand raised to the side of their face. Both individuals wear robes. The etching is enclosed within an oval frame with no detailed background.

artworks.title: Lear and Cordelia
artworks.artist: Thomas Butts, Jr. after William Blake
artworks.medium: engraving
artworks.description: The engraving depicts two figures in the upper body, closely positioned in an oval frame. The figure on the left has long hair and a beard, with distinct facial features and is pointing towards the other figure. The figure on the right has long hair, soft facial features, and rests their hand on their cheek, appearing contemplative. Both wear richly detailed robes, and the background is cross-hatched within the oval frame.

artworks.title: Lear and Cordelia
artworks.artist: Thomas Butts, Jr. after William Blake
artworks.medium: engraving
artworks.description: The image shows two figures within an oval frame. One figure is older with a long beard and hair, facing right. The other figure is younger with long, curly hair, looking towards the older figure. Both figures wear detailed clothing and the background is a dark oval. The focus is on their faces and hair. No jewelry is visible.

artworks.title: Joseph of Arimathea Among the Rocks of Albion
artworks.medium: engraving
artworks.description: The engraving depicts a man standing with his arms crossed over his chest. He is turned slightly with his legs close together. The man has a long beard, a serious expression, and is wearing a head covering and draped garment that falls to his knees. The man is standing on rocky ground, with a body of water on the left and rugged rock formations behind him.

artworks.title: George Cumberland's Card
artworks.medium: engraving in brown
artworks.description: This drawing depicts several ethereal figures surrounding the name "Mr. Cumberland" in calligraphy. The figures are floating and posed gracefully, interacting with elements like ribbons and scythes. One central figure holds a scythe, while above the name, a procession of flying figures moves to the right. Another figure to the right holds a large piece of fabric, possibly representing wind or sea interacting with waves below. The drawing has a gentle tone with soft lines and a classic, illustrative style, enhanced by floral decorations and elegant typography.
